verdict.rationale: The repo ships an official template/SKILL.md with `name: template-skill` and a placeholder description field (docs-73, docs-29), so developers do not need to reverse-engineer existing skills. The Agent Skills spec documents the required YAML frontmatter, including `name`/`description` and the 1-1024 character description rule, plus the directory layout (docs-44, docs-17, docs-51, docs-66). Claude Code docs, the repo README and a skill-creator skill further support authoring (docs-1, gh-3, docs-13). Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of authoring a new skill from the template; the runtime probe only verified installing an existing spec-conformant skill.
